# August Blu

> August Blu is an independent anti-pop music artist. The music is honest,
> raw, and emotional — made for "the people who feel invisible." August Blu
> is intentionally **not on mainstream streaming services** (no Spotify, no
> Apple Music). The music lives on Bandcamp, YouTube, the live stage, and on
> augustblu.com — places you have to choose to come to.

## About

August Blu makes music for people who feel invisible — "the ones who hate
themselves some days, hate the world on the others, but still get up and try
to make it out the door anyway." The work is a deliberate counter to a culture
of endless scrolling and numbness: music that makes you stop and feel.

The sound shifts to whatever each song needs; what stays constant is honesty
over polish. Core message: *Love is all we have and all we need. Do it anyway.*
